files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 web-app with main.jac entry point and [serve] base_route_app app. Jac supplies its core client dependencies automatically; add only packages directly used by this small project tracker.
Define Task node with title, alias, notes, and is_draft fields, plus title/alias accessors. This deterministic slice does not invoke the source app's optional LLM alias generator.

Define Project node with name, tldr, is_draft; methods create_sub_project, create_task, draft_sub_project, draft_task; public functions create_root_project, get_projects, get_project, get_sub_projects, get_tasks, create_sub_project, create_task. Connect nodes with graph edges and recursively find nested projects.
Implement FindTask, Approver, Cleaner graph walkers and public approve_project, approve_task, delete_project, delete_task functions. Traversal must stay within the chosen project tree.
Style the project board, create form, hierarchy list, and status messages without shadcn.

Render root projects on the home page; provide a form to create a root project and list nested project/task counts. Use the public server functions with awaited calls, plus loading, empty, and error states.
Import public project and walker functions for server registration, import styles.css and ProjectBoard, and mount the board as the public app at /.

verify.steps: Run independent project hierarchy tests from the source repository's model and walker contracts; check, build, then open / and create/view a project.

assumption: Clean Jac 0.36.1 workspace; inferred placement. This reproduces the deterministic project-tree slice of Rui/pm, without its optional AI planner, auth, or shadcn UI.
